notes: Preserves enabled USysTableOfLists definitions and ValidateLoops field expansion against the active USysEnv scope while using explicit context/reference paths and returning deterministic findings plus skipped-definition diagnostics instead of global registry state, modal errors, and Excel automation.

Preserves per-field non-null/non-empty unmatched-code checks and continuation after invalid dynamic fields; identifiers are resolved and quoted safely, NOCASE approximates Access collation, repeated projected findings are deduplicated, and field errors are returned structurally.

Preserves project-wide and active-SU query scopes against USysAllSpecs, including null/blank findings and the SU-driven left join, while using explicit context and reference paths, NOCASE matching, deterministic deduplication/order, and structured output instead of global registry state and Excel automation.

Compares the same eight core project tables against a caller-selectable SQLite template, defaulting to bundled VP08 Sample, and returns deterministic structured differences instead of displaying a message or opening Excel.
Preserves template-to-project field comparison and ignores project-only fields; missing project tables are reported explicitly rather than surfacing an unhandled DAO lookup error.
Matches template fields case-insensitively against SQLite project fields and returns explicit missing-field rows rather than mutating module-level arrays.
Reads normalized declared type and optional declared size from SQLite PRAGMA metadata into local data frames rather than shared module-level state.
Preserves separate Type and Size findings while normalizing equivalent SQLite declared-type aliases; size is compared only when encoded in the SQLite declaration.
Returns a data frame with table, field, difference, expected, and actual values instead of automating Excel; callers control presentation and export.
The private Sample-only manual test harness is replaced by package tests and the exported API defaults to the bundled Sample template.
Preserves the five Roman-numeral classes and exact Access boundaries; vectorized numeric validation is explicit and out-of-range or missing values return typed NA rather than an unset VBA Variant.
Preserves character labels 1 through 5, including the unbounded fifth class above 0.8; vectorized numeric validation is explicit and negative or missing values return typed NA.

Preserves the unrounded legacy score formula, exact class boundaries, and SVShowClass raw-score option as an explicit argument; vectorized results use R doubles and invalid square-root inputs return NA instead of displaying a modal error.

Preserves the unrounded legacy score formula, exact class boundaries, and SVShowClass raw-score option as an explicit argument; vectorized results use R doubles and invalid square-root inputs return NA instead of displaying a modal error.
Preserves the plus and 1-through-9 boundaries while returning one stable character type; values at or below -1 and missing values return typed NA instead of an unset VBA Variant.

The VBA function accidentally overwrites both attempted rounding branches and acts as identity; classification APIs preserve that observed identity, while this standalone replacement implements the documented minimum-and-rounding intent with stable numeric output.
Replaces locale-formatted text above 0.01 and numeric output below it with an explicit vectorized numeric operation whose digits and minimum are caller-controlled; missing values remain missing.
Preserves the observed operation: values above 100 are capped at 100, while all other finite values are returned unchanged; the package implementation is vectorized.
Preserves Access component composition and its null-degree and zero-for-null-minute-or-second behavior, while adding vectorization, explicit numeric validation, and double-precision calculation.

Preserves absolute-value longitude decomposition into degrees, minutes, and seconds while returning a data frame, supporting vectors, and retaining double precision instead of VBA Single intermediates.

Preserves absolute-value latitude decomposition into degrees, minutes, and seconds while returning a data frame, supporting vectors, and retaining double precision instead of VBA Single intermediates.
The component helper is consolidated into the vectorized DMS result; nonnegative inputs match Access integer degree extraction and coordinate APIs reject unsupported nonnumeric values explicitly.
The component helper is consolidated into the vectorized DMS result; nonnegative inputs match Access integer minute extraction and double precision replaces VBA Single intermediates.
The component helper is consolidated into the vectorized DMS result; nonnegative inputs match Access second extraction and double precision replaces VBA Single intermediates.
Preserves absolute-value longitude decomposition into degrees and decimal minutes while returning a data frame, supporting vectors, and retaining double precision instead of VBA Single intermediates.
Preserves absolute-value latitude decomposition into degrees and decimal minutes while returning a data frame, supporting vectors, and retaining double precision instead of VBA Single intermediates.
UI file selection is separated from the package API; complete VP08 families are validated before deterministic DuckDB attachment.
Access links eight tables and suppresses link errors; the package attaches the containing SQLite database only after complete-family and VP08 validation.
Reads the canonical SQLite _table_metadata translation of the Access Env table Description property and returns Unknown when absent.
Activation persists the normalized SQLite path supplied at attachment rather than decoding an Access linked-table connection string.
Coordinator-scoped temporary views replace persistent Access QueryDef rewrites; project activation restores unfiltered views, deactivates any SU, resets CurrPlotlist, and clears SUPath.

A new coordinator has no shared persistent QueryDefs to compare; startup deterministically restores the configured project and optional persisted SU. Failed SU recovery leaves the project active and unfiltered.
The configured complete VP08 SQLite family is attached and activated; any recovery failure falls back to an explicit Sample database and persists that recovered state.
Detachment removes only the DuckDB attachment and explicitly refuses to detach the active project instead of suppressing deletion errors.

SQLite declares valid foreign keys in table schemas and save-as preserves them transactionally. The stale Env.StartDate to Metadata.StartDate declaration is omitted: the Windows Access oracle raises DAO 3799 because Env has Date but no StartDate, and the live database has no Env-Metadata relation.
The project branch is a transactional SQLite core-family clone; the SU and hierarchy branches are implemented by vpro_su_save_as and vpro_hierarchy_save_as.
Temporary Access import tables are replaced by direct transactional SQLite copying.
Direct SQLite copying renames the core family and preserves schema, indexes, foreign keys, data, and version metadata.
All eight target-family collisions are rejected before copying rather than checking only the target Env table.
The copied family is the same eight project suffixes identified by the Access predicate.

Exact _SU suffix matching, structural validation, and explicit caller selection replace Access substring scanning and UI prompts; attachment does not activate the SU and shared SQLite attachments are reused.
Reads the same active-project Env/Admin pair as the Access inner-join record source but returns separate base rows to avoid ambiguous duplicate field names and dependence on mutable QueryDefs.
An explicit package API replaces the bound-form save command; named Env/Admin updates and audit rows commit atomically against canonical SQLite base tables.
An explicit caller-supplied plot number replaces form-global new-record state. Creation validates optional Env/Admin values and atomically inserts one canonical pair without depending on focus order.

The package transactionally creates the Env/Admin pair directly instead of briefly setting and clearing StartDate to dirty the Admin side. It omits the unreachable repair block and seven null-to-null checkbox audit rows observed in Access.

The Access confirmation and cancellation code is unreachable after an unconditional Exit Sub. The package exposes an explicit caller operation and validates source integrity and target collisions before mutation.

Preserves Access relationship cascades and no-audit behavior while intentionally updating every SU attached to the explicit context. The legacy active-SU update code is unreachable and leaves membership under the old key.

An explicit package operation replaces the standard bound-form delete command. It preserves the observed project-family cascade, audit-history deletion, no-new-audit behavior, and active selections while intentionally removing matching membership from every SU attached to the context.
The package has no focus-driven implicit save; callers explicitly submit validated named changes through one transactional update operation.
Field-level audit generation is part of the same SQLite transaction as the Env/Admin update rather than a separate bound-form BeforeUpdate event.
Preserves audit-strength rules and project/user/plot/table/field before-after evidence while using explicit user identity, UTC timestamps, base tables, and atomic SQLite writes.

Restores one explicitly selected audit event transactionally. _Env fields are resolved uniquely across physical Env and Admin schemas, child rows require exact plot-ID identity, current values must match AfterEdit, and audit deletion is opt-in rather than reproducing Access selection and cleanup side effects.

Corrects the legacy Admin restoration defect by resolving the audited field to exactly one physical schema, validates typed BeforeEdit values, rejects stale or ambiguous targets, and restores only one existing field without implicit vegetation-row deletion.
Environmental FS882 changes are recorded with logical table suffix _Env; this includes Admin fields edited through the joined USysEnv form, matching the Access form-level mapping.

Reads the active project's canonical audit table for one explicit plot and preserves the Access query's chronological EditWhen ordering, with deterministic tie-breaking and no dependency on mutable QueryDefs.

An explicit read-only package API replaces opening the Access audit form; project and plot filters are supplied from the active context and caller rather than Access form state. Complete returned event rows can be passed explicitly to the separate guarded restoration API.

Reads the active project's canonical _Other rows for one explicit existing plot and applies the SubOtherXL DataName ordering with stable ID tie-breaking instead of depending on mutable QueryDef or form state.

Explicit create and existing-row update APIs replace bound-form writes; collision-checked IDs, Access-observed user-flag defaults, validated changes, and _Other child-ID audit rows commit atomically. Oracle-observed deletion adds no audit rows; restoration remains separate.

Reads canonical _Humus rows for one explicit existing plot and preserves the SoilHumus descending UpperDepth and Horizon order with stable ID tie-breaking instead of depending on mutable QueryDef and form state.

Explicit create and existing-row update APIs replace bound-form writes; collision-checked IDs, validated changes, and _Humus child-ID audit rows commit atomically. Oracle-observed deletion adds no audit rows; restoration remains separate.

Reads canonical _Mineral rows for one explicit existing plot and preserves the SoilMineral ascending UpperDepth and Horizon order with stable ID tie-breaking instead of depending on mutable QueryDef and form state.
Reads canonical _Veg rows for one explicit existing plot and orders by Species and ID instead of depending on mutable QueryDef and form state.

Explicit create and update APIs preserve child-ID audit semantics and stable IDs across species edits. Because Access permits duplicate vegetation IDs, package operations require exactly one PlotNumber-ID match and fail safely on ambiguity.

The package requires a nonblank species and explicit values but does not reproduce the focus-changing message shown when all primary cover fields are null. Creation is atomic and uses a collision-checked signed 32-bit ID.

Explicit create and existing-row update APIs replace bound-form writes; collision-checked IDs, validated changes, and _Mineral child-ID audit rows commit atomically. Oracle-observed deletion adds no audit rows; restoration remains separate.

Explicit _vpro_su_policy metadata and caller-supplied manage_master_su/attach_master_su permission callbacks replace the Access username allow-list, ambiguous master substring test, unused Tag field, and embedded password.
Copies an explicitly marked master transactionally without attaching or mutating it and records source provenance; no password bypass or inferred merge-back path is retained.
Coordinator-scoped temporary views implement the Env-SU-Admin intersection. Validation precedes mutation, diagnostics are returned, and blank or orphan rows are never deleted implicitly.
Detachment explicitly refuses the active SU, removes only lifecycle registration, and preserves a shared SQLite attachment while any project or other SU still uses it.
Temporary Access imports are replaced by direct transactional SQLite copying of the SU table, rows, explicit indexes, and translated metadata.
The copied SU is written under the requested exact _SU name without attachment or activation, while current SU state remains unchanged.

Exact _Hierarchy suffix selection, structural validation, and explicit caller paths replace Access substring scanning and UI prompts; shared SQLite attachments are reused and attachment does not activate the hierarchy.
Explicit activation replaces direct registry assignment, persists the normalized SQLite path, and exposes a coordinator-scoped Hierarchy compatibility view over the selected named table.
Detachment explicitly refuses the active hierarchy, removes only lifecycle registration, and preserves a shared SQLite attachment while another resource still uses it.
Temporary Access staging is replaced by direct transactional SQLite copying of the hierarchy table, rows, explicit indexes, and translated metadata.
The copied hierarchy is written under the requested exact _Hierarchy name without attachment or activation, while current hierarchy state remains unchanged.
